subject: Original checked callback accessor for existing APCIE port slices, using only their existing host fake register file
source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative path LF; sorted; five files listed below; receipt/log excluded

implementation.entry: apr_bind_fake(struct apr_accessor *, const struct apb_io *, struct apb_io *)
implementation.wiring: Existing apb_bringup_port0 and apl_link_port0 are invoked with the accessor-supplied apb_io in test_register_accessor.c. No production slice or live IOKit adapter was changed.
implementation.fake_provenance: test_register_accessor.c includes the unchanged test_linkup.c under a renamed legacy main, reusing its actual static register arrays, IO callbacks, plans and counters.
implementation.compiler_guard: Requires APB_HOST_TEST_ACCESSOR; KERNEL and APB_FAKE_REGISTER_FILE each produce an explicit compile refusal. Thus this executable cannot compile in the existing fake shared-write escape path.
implementation.shared_writes: Always refused by accessor before any writer callback, across PMGR, RC, PHY, PHYIP, AXI, FUSE and P0PHY. Existing slices are compiled without APB_FAKE_REGISTER_FILE; their shared writer/pin branches stay compiled out.
implementation.local_fake_writes: PORT0/ECAM0 only, checked aligned bounds; ECAM0+0xa0 full-word write refused. Only halfword target is ECAM0+0xa0, preserving the adjacent status halfword.
implementation.bounds: Region lookup rejects unknown IDs. width <= size and offset <= size-width avoid unsigned end-addition overflow; 32-bit alignment and precise halfword restriction before callbacks. FUSE read whitelist unchanged.
implementation.failure_ownership: Failed read preserves output even if fake clobbers its temporary; backend failures remain APB_IO. Bind failure leaves both outputs unchanged. No rollback claim for an arbitrary failing backend write.
implementation.lifetime: Caller-owned, single-threaded accessor/callback context stable until all slice calls return; callbacks copied at bind; recursive accessor binding refused.
implementation.delay: Forwards only to existing fake elapsed-time accumulator; no sleep or hardware timer.
implementation.security_limit: Explicit host-only compile contract and tested fake wiring, not a security boundary against a C caller supplying arbitrary callback code.

cases: All nine region boundaries, unknown region and UINT32_MAX offsets, alignment and null outputs; no backend dispatch on rejection
Every shared region write rejected before fake writer; local fake word roundtrip and LNKCTL2 halfword preserving sentinel LNKSTA2
Failed 32/16-bit reads clobber only temporary; missing callbacks, backend write fault, invalid/unbound/recursive binding and failed-bind output preservation

Existing slice 2 reads PMGR through accessor then APB_GATED with no writes; slice 3 refuses that record; explicit synthetic completed record permits two accessor reads then stops at PERST gate with no writes or pin calls
Four negative compiler cases: missing host opt-in, KERNEL, old fake shared-write opt-in, and NDEBUG test assertion guard
Preprocessed actual slice shared-write branches contain no writer calls; actual linkup pin branch contains no pin callback
Actual C objects linked to a C++14 caller through extern C, executed on host
mutants: clobber read output on failed callback
validation.mutation_baseline: Unmodified accessor is compiled and must run successfully before any mutant is tested. Every mutant compiles and then fails an assertion; compile failures do not count.
validation.initial_test_harness_correction: A synthetic complete record initially retained the preceding expected gated_writes=1 and was correctly refused by slice 3. Test now zeroes this synthetic record before setting its declared complete fields; no production gate changed. Final checks rerun successfully.
validation.repository_wide_checks: Not rerun for this bounded host-only slice; evidence here is the focused sanitized host/accessor/linkage/negative-compile/preprocessor suite, not repository-wide readiness.

provenance.new_code: Original darwin-lab implementation; no upstream source copied or relicensed.
provenance.references: Existing local original bringup/linkup interfaces and fake test file. No GPL source was read or pasted for this accessor.

next_gate: Independent source review; any future hardware accessor or adapter is a separate implementation and authorization. This accessor is deliberately unusable in a kernel build.
